design_system.name: Humanist Precision
design_system.description: A soft, utility-focused aesthetic that blends Swiss precision with organic warmth. It prioritizes clarity, calm, and efficiency for HR tasks.
design_system.theme_strategy: Light Mode Primary (Paper-like) with High-Contrast Data

visual_enhancers.gradients: None. Use solid colors and subtle background patterns (dots/grid) only.

buttons.primary: bg-slate-800 text-white hover:bg-slate-900 rounded-full px-6 py-2.5 font-medium transition-all active:scale-95 shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-full px-6 py-2.5 font-medium transition-all
buttons.ghost: text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900 rounded-lg px-4 py-2

cards.dashboard_widget: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-100 p-6 shadow-[0_2px_8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] flex flex-col justify-between h-full
cards.stat_card: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-100 p-6 flex items-center justify-between hover:border-slate-300 transition-colors

inputs.default: bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 text-slate-900 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-200 focus:border-slate-400 transition-all placeholder:text-slate-400

badges.pending: bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-100 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold

badges.rejected: bg-red-50 text-red-700 border border-red-100 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold

layout_strategies.detail_view: Use Shadcn Sheet (Side Panel) for drilling down into Employee Details or Leave Requests. Do not navigate away from the dashboard.

login_hero.usage: Right side of the split-screen login page. Cover mode.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. TAILWIND CONFIG: Update tailwind.config.js to use the font families defined above.
3. SHADCN CUSTOMIZATION: Override default Shadcn radius to 0.75rem (rounded-xl) and use the slate color palette defined in 'colors'.
4. LAYOUT: Implement the 'Bento Grid' for the dashboard. Use 'col-span-2' for main charts and 'col-span-1' for stats.
5. INTERACTION: Use 'Sonner' for all success/error toasts. Do not use standard alerts.
6. DATA-TESTID: Ensure every button, input, and card has a unique data-testid attribute (e.g., 'login-submit-btn', 'leave-balance-card').
7. NAVIGATION: Create a Sidebar navigation for Desktop and a Bottom Tab bar for Mobile.
8. AUTH FLOW: Login page must be split screen (Form Left, Image Right).
9. LEAVE REQUEST: Use a Shadcn Dialog or Sheet for the 'Apply Leave' form to keep context.
universal_guidelines: Avoid gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors or subtle noise.
Use 2x more padding than you think is necessary.
Never center text in cards unless it is a single big number.
Use 'text-slate-500' for labels and 'text-slate-900' for values.
All interactive elements must have a hover state that changes background or border color.
